stem:
Veer adds copper sulphate and sodium hydroxide to crushed beans and sees a violet colour.

What does that show?

options.text: Violet means only that the beans are purple-skinned.
Protein is present only in meat, so the test cannot work on beans.

teacher.key_rationale: The violet biuret-style result here marks protein. It is not starch, not skin colour, and not meat-only.
